name: qUSm10_statprior_var
title: Stationary Exchangeable VAR(p): Heaps Ten/Twenty-Variable Prior
description: A stationary VAR using the exchangeable partial-autocorrelation prior from Section 3.2 of Heaps (2023), with fixed m = 10, 20 application hyperparameters from supplement S6.2: e = 0, f = sqrt(0.700), g = 2.100, h = 0.333; Sigma ~ IW(m + 4, I).
